categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: aviation equipment and special refrigeration. Aviation equipment includes the research, development, production, sales, and repair of aviation oxygen systems, onboard fuel tank inerting protection systems, aircraft auxiliary fuel tanks, and sensitive components. Special refrigeration covers military and civilian refrigeration equipment, including air conditioning for military vehicles, ships, and industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as oxygen regulation, onboard molecular sieve oxygen generation, multi-bed molecular sieve oxygen control, and integrated oxygen supply and anti-G systems. It employs digital and flexible manufacturing lines, including digital production lines for concentrators and rubber vulcanization. The company has a strong R&D foundation with numerous patents and has developed proprietary technologies for aviation oxygen systems, fuel tank inerting, and special refrigeration equipment, achieving international leading or advanced levels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic military branches (Air Force, Army, Navy, Rocket Force), major domestic aircraft manufacturers, and some civil aviation companies. The company serves military aircraft in development and in service, as well as civil and general aviation aircraft. The special refrigeration segment serves military vehicles, ships, aerospace, and industrial sectors, with expanding civilian applications in high-temperature resistant air conditioning and specialized refrigeration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated within China, serving domestic military and civil aviation markets. There is no significant mention of overseas markets, indicating a focus on the domestic market.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream core component integrator and manufacturer within the aerospace and special refrigeration supply chains. It supplies critical subsystems and components such as oxygen systems, fuel tank inerting systems, and auxiliary fuel tanks to aircraft manufacturers and military end-users, positioning itself as a key system-level supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core technology capabilities, fulfilling military modernization responsibilities, expanding strategic industries, and accelerating market and institutional reforms. R&D focuses on intelligent oxygen supply, integrated anti-G oxygen systems, digital manufacturing, and new product development for military and civil aviation. The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, digital transformation, and talent development to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized aviation equipment and special refrigeration products to military and civil customers. The company uses a direct sales model for military products and a combination of direct and limited dealer sales for civilian refrigeration products. Revenue recognition follows contract fulfillment and product delivery, with pricing based on military pricing principles or negotiated agreements for civilian products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically as the sole specialized manufacturer of aviation oxygen systems and onboard fuel tank inerting protection systems, and as the largest domestic producer of aircraft auxiliary fuel tanks and a leading special refrigeration equipment manufacturer. It maintains a dominant market position within the Chinese aerospace and military refrigeration sectors, supported by strong technological capabilities and long-term customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.21 billion, representing an 8.89% year-over-year increase, primarily driven by growth in aviation business. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 193 million, a 20.9% decrease from the previous year, impacted by increased R&D expenses and reduced government subsidies. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 3.58 billion and equity of RMB 2.48 billion, reflecting steady growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique value in providing highly reliable, technologically advanced, and customized aviation life-support and fuel system components critical for military and civil aircraft safety and performance. Its products feature international leading technologies, high integration, safety, and adaptability to harsh environments. The company also offers comprehensive repair and maintenance services and leverages digital manufacturing and innovation to ensure quality and responsiveness, differentiating itself as a trusted system-level supplier in strategic aerospace and refrigeration markets.
